{{Quote|Last bottle from the Coronet City Winery is over there. One drink before we jump into the abyss?|General Adele Konya|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coronet City Winery''' was a winery located in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] prior to the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], when the winery was destroyed. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Adele Konya]], a former member of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] cabinet, acquired what she believed was the last bottle from the winery during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] fight to secure the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region.
